# netstack-smoltcp

Copied from the vendored `rust-client/vendor/netstack-smoltcp` in the local CSQTT source checkout.
The crate version is 0.2.4. Original author: cavivie. MIT OR Apache-2.0 licenses are retained in `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`.

FOCSQ uses this mobile-client TCP implementation to return raw IPv4 packets to Wintun. The Windows direct socket binding and routing policy live outside this crate.
